waiver_of_premium.doc: HDFC Life Income Benefit on Accidental Disability Riders (product page link)
waiver_of_premium.quote: In the event of Total Permanent Disability due to accident, you will be paid a regular monthly income equal to 1% of Sum Assured for a fixed period of 10 years.
waiver_of_premium.note: The rider pays a monthly income on accidental total permanent disability and nothing else.

accidental_death.value: not covered. If the life assured dies while income payments are outstanding, the nominee keeps receiving them.
accidental_death.doc: HDFC Life Income Benefit on Accidental Disability Riders (product page link)
accidental_death.quote: In case the death of the life assured occurs while the benefit payments are outstanding then the nominee will continue to receive the outstanding monthly benefit payments.

accidental_disability.value: Monthly income of 1% of sum assured for 10 years on accidental total permanent disability (inability to work, or loss of two limbs, both eyes, or one limb and one eye). Benefit starts after 6 months of continuous disability, immediately for loss by severance of limbs. No waiting period. No partial disability benefit.

rider_term.value: Minimum 5 years; maximum consistent with the base policy. Cannot exceed the outstanding base policy term.

premium_paying_rules.value: Premium payment term at most the outstanding premium payment term of the base plan. Can be taken at inception or on a later policy anniversary. Frequency follows the base policy.
